name.zh: Cruziana 双叶爬行沟凹陷教学印迹

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: long paired furrows carrying repeated oblique scratch marks. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: negative-impression; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：长条成对沟槽带重复斜向刮痕。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凹陷印迹；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Pennsylvanian Tidal Flat: Systematic Ichnology I
sources.supports: Named trace morphologies and taxonomic caveats; source specimens from Carboniferous Waverly

reconstruction_notes.en: Original negative-impression teaching slab with one long gently curved pair of depressed furrows and repeated bilateral oblique recessed scratches. Neutral-gray geometry must show internal relief from top and oblique views; substrate outline is not the identifier. KGS basic ichnogenus discussion consulted, whose cited specimens are mostly positive hyporelief; this is an interpretive negative display as frozen, not a copy of those specimens. Nominal0.30m slab, depths and scratch spacing are art choices. No named ichnospecies, excavated specimen, specific producer, Asaphus connection, exact motion or coexistence claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创凹陷教学岩板，以一条缓弯成对凹沟和双侧重复斜向凹刮痕表达。中性灰几何须在顶视及斜视显示内部浮雕，底板轮廓不作识别依据。已查KGS潜迹属基本论述，其具名标本多为底面正浮雕；本项按冻结要求作原创新的负印迹示意，不复制这些标本。0.30米名义岩板、深度及刮痕间距为美术设定。不指定种、出土标本、制造者，不绑定Asaphus，不主张精确运动或共存。

claim_scope: Interpretive trace morphology: original negative crawling impression or positive fossil-relief display, not excavated specimen replication or a known producer.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
